name: nautiloid
title: New game → Nautiloid escaped (the launch bar)
task: Escape the Nautiloid as fast as you can: create your character from the brief, then get off the ship.
scored_by: Passed when the Nautiloid escape milestone is reached (the ship crashes with you off it). Nothing else counts toward the score: optional rescues, loot and dialogue earn nothing. The game time to escape is reported next to it.
about: The launch-bar series (3/3 clean, 2026-10-13, series naut): a new game, character creation from the brief, the prologue until the Nautiloid crashes. v2: converted from scenarios/nautiloid.json (same start, goal, caps and brief), dice seeded, difficulty fixed to Balanced.

character.brief: A half-elf fighter, once a Baldur's Gate city watch sergeant.
